mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_order (tenant_id, customer_id, total_amount, status, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotentKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, total_amount, status, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_order WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
